note: Small animations of one character: a few poses of the same figure joined into an equal-cell sprite sheet (services/character_animations.py, ui/src/lib/characterAnimations.ts). Each pose is one Qwen picture made from the character's own picture as an identity reference, on a plain screen, keyed and cropped. `view` picks the framing sentence, `loop` how the sheet plays (loop | pingpong | once), `template` the Video 2D card that plays it.
identity: The same character as the reference image: same face, proportions, colours, outfit and art style. {description}
negative: photo, photorealistic, 3D render, blurry, text, watermark, speech bubble, panel border, frame, multiple characters, background scenery, floor, cast shadow, turnaround sheet, collage of views

viewNegatives.bust: full body, whole body, standing figure, waist, hands, legs, feet, boots

views.side: Exact side view of the whole body, facing right, seen from head to boots, centred, the same size as in the reference picture.
views.front: Front view of the whole body, seen from head to boots, centred, the same size as in the reference picture.
views.bust: Close-up portrait: only the head, neck and shoulders of the character, the picture cropped at the chest so no waist, hands, legs or feet are in it, facing the viewer, centred, the face large and filling the upper half of the picture.

summary.es: Ciclo de paso de perfil en cuatro poses: contacto, paso, contacto, paso. Mira a la derecha.
summary.en: Side-view gait in four poses: contact, passing, contact, passing. Looks right.

poses.prompt: Walking: the contact pose of a walk cycle, the front leg stretched forward with the heel of the boot just touching the ground, the back leg stretched behind pushing off on the toes of the boot, the arm nearest the viewer swinging back and the other arm forward.

Walking: the passing pose of a walk cycle, balancing on one straight leg while the other knee is bent with the boot lifted off the ground and passing forward under the body, the two legs close together, arms hanging near the sides.

Walking: the contact pose of a walk cycle with the other foot, the leg nearest the viewer stretched forward with the heel just touching the ground and the other leg stretched behind pushing off on its toes, the arm nearest the viewer swinging forward and the other arm back.

Walking: the passing pose of a walk cycle with the other foot, balancing on the leg nearest the viewer while the far leg is bent with its boot lifted and passing forward, the two legs close together, arms hanging near the sides.

summary.es: Carrera de perfil en cuatro poses: contacto, vuelo, contacto, vuelo. Mira a la derecha.
summary.en: Side-view run in four poses: contact, flight, contact, flight. Looks right.

poses.prompt: Running: the contact pose of a run cycle, the front knee bent with the boot landing ahead of the body, the back leg stretched behind on its toes, the body leaning forward, the arms bent and pumping, one forward and one back.
Running: the flight pose of a run cycle, both boots off the ground, the back knee drawn up under the body, the front leg reaching forward, the body leaning forward, the arms bent and pumping.

Running: the contact pose of a run cycle with the other foot, the leg nearest the viewer landing ahead of the body with the knee bent, the other leg stretched behind on its toes, the body leaning forward, the arms pumping the other way.

Running: the flight pose of a run cycle with the other foot, both boots off the ground, the knee nearest the viewer drawn up under the body, the other leg reaching forward, the body leaning forward, the arms pumping the other way.
